x1.description: scalar or array. Specifies the dividend.
constraints: x1 and x2 must have broadcast-compatible shapes

x2.description: scalar or array. Specifies the divisor. ``x1`` and ``x2`` should either have same shape or be broadcast compatible.
constraints: x1 and x2 must have broadcast-compatible shapes

output.description: An array containing the remainder of element-wise division of ``x1`` by ``x2`` with same sign as the elements of ``x2``.

constraints: x1 and x2 must have broadcast-compatible shapes
